correctness.rationale: Orthogonality of constant, centered linear and centered quadratic vectors gives exact reproducing row with coefficients 3[10j²+(6−12m)j+3m²−3m+2]/[m(m+1)(m+2)]. Factoring identifies two roots and signed region. An exact quadratic Euler–Maclaurin identity with periodic Bernoulli offsets evaluates the negative part. Binomial expansion gives the uniform m^-2 phase coefficient; B2 bounds and density of the irrational rotation along m≡3 mod5 prove both sharp asymptotic extrema. Independent rational Gram inversion (m=3..50) and 70-digit comparison (m=3..250) pass; finite tests are not used as proof of infinite claims.

value.rationale: The endpoint \(\ell^\infty\) noise gain is an intrinsic sharp stability invariant of equispaced quadratic least-squares regression, not an arbitrary parameter slice. The exact all-sample formula identifies the negative influence block; the sharp distinct second-order limit points show that even the simple fixed-degree regression benchmark has irreducible lattice arithmetic in its finite-grid correction. This gives a reproducible sharp boundary-sensitivity calibration and rules out a conventional two-term constant-coefficient expansion. No claim of a global projector norm is needed.
